Matthews (DAL) makes contact with DeRozan's (SAS) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Forbes (SAS) briefly grasps Matthews (DAL) but does not affect his SQBR.

Matthews (DAL) makes marginal contact with DeRozan (SAS) that does not affect his SQBR.

Aldridge (SAS) establishes a screening position in Matthews' (DAL) path and firms up on his left leg.
